actor: pretraining research lead at a non-Google open-weight model lab
job: Pretraining and post-training a discrete or masked-denoising text-diffusion language model and preparing it for an open-weight release with a model card.
outcome: A second independent open-weight text-diffusion LM family shipped with downloadable weights and a model card under a permissive license.
motivation: Owning the second diffusion-LM release stakes an early claim in a category Unsloth just proved is locally trainable and unfilled.

task.who: the lab's pretraining and post-training research team
task.what: train and release an open-weight diffusion-LM family
task.where: the lab's training cluster and model-release hub
task.why: stake the second claim in an unfilled open category
task.how: discrete/masked-denoising diffusion objective on open weights

actor: maintainer of a mainstream local inference or training stack
job: Adding first-class support for the text-diffusion denoising graph so a diffusion-LM can be run or fine-tuned natively, not merely wrapped around Unsloth's path.
outcome: A second mainstream local stack ships documented native fine-tuning or inference support for a text-diffusion LM on consumer hardware.
motivation: Matching demand for the locally trainable diffusion-LM keeps the stack from ceding the emerging format to Unsloth alone.

task.who: the runtime or training-library core maintainer team
task.what: implement the diffusion-LM denoising graph natively
task.where: llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, MLX, Axolotl, or TRL
task.why: avoid ceding the diffusion-LM format to one toolchain
task.how: native denoising kernels plus documented training recipes

job: Hardening the locally-trainable DiffusionGemma path with stable training recipes, quantization, and docs that establish a reusable blueprint for the diffusion-LM denoising graph.
outcome: A documented, reproducible local diffusion-LM training reference that other labs and stacks can copy to seed the category.
motivation: Establishing the canonical local diffusion-LM training pattern entrenches first-mover authority over the format it just introduced.

task.who: the toolchain's training-kernel and quantization engineers
task.what: stabilize and document the local diffusion-LM training path
task.where: the downloadable local fine-tuning app and its docs
task.why: set the copyable blueprint that seeds the category
task.how: quantization-aware training plus reproducible LoRA recipes
